name: FX Regression - EURUSD
description: Simple 10/30 SMA crossover on EUR/USD for regression testing. Counter=USD, fxRate=1.
source:
# Simple SMA crossover - EURUSD regression test
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

fast = ma(period=10, type=MAType.sma)(close)
slow = ma(period=30, type=MAType.sma)(close)

is_bullish = fast > slow
is_bearish = fast < slow
held = hold_until()(enter=is_bullish, exit=is_bearish)

long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)
